title: toc
text:
toc

reference

low- & high-res. pseoduobulks
from scRNA-seq reference data

setup

add core-level metadata
write polygons to .parquet
format into SingleCellExperiment
negative & false codes as altExps

filtering

based on cell-level metrics
& distance to FOV borders

signatures

MSigDB, in-house, public
& pan-cancer T cell atlas

signaling

using COMMOT

clustering

semi-supervised for all but stromal
split into NK/T, myeloid stromal & tumor cells

subclustering

semi-supervised for all but stromal
subset-specific feature selection

contexts

cluster cells based on composition
of 20um radial neighborhoods
tumoral density analysis

processing

pooling of results into single object
dimensionality reduction
add clinical metadata

comm.clust.

signaling-based clustering

exploratory

visualization across results


nomenclature

core identifiers = patient + replicate + tissue + group

patient: 01-12; replicate: 1 or 2 if any, 0 otherwise
(e.g., 071 = patient 7, 1st rep; 020 = patient 2, only rep)
tissue:

EY = eye
LN = lymph node
NP = nasopharyngeal
SO = soft tissue (excluded)

group:

m = mantle
n = nodal
d = diffuse

library(qs)
library(Seurat)
library(scuttle)
library(patchwork)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
source("code/_utils.R")





qs <- list.files("data/ref", "qs$", full.names=TRUE)
names(qs) <- gsub("\\.qs", "", basename(qs))
se <- lapply(qs, \(.) {
    so <- qread(.)
    se <- as.SingleCellExperiment(so)
    logcounts(se) <- NULL
    dr <- tail(reducedDims(se), 1)[[1]]
    reducedDims(se) <- list(UMAP=dr)
    gs <- VariableFeatures(so)
    gs <- rownames(se) %in% gs
    rowData(se)$hvg <- gs
    se
}); sapply(se, dim)

# exclude cells less than 'd' from any FOV border;

# wrangling
cd <- data.frame(colData(sce))
cd$cpa <- with(cd, nCount_RNA/Area.um2)
df <- cbind(cd, d <- .d2b(cd)) |>
    pivot_longer(all_of(colnames(d))) |>
    mutate(value=value*1e3) |>
    mutate(name=factor(name, 
        c("t", "r", "b", "l"),
        c("top", "right", "bottom", "left")))
fd <- df |>
    group_by(name, value) |>
    summarise_at("cpa", mean) |>
    arrange(value) |> group_by(name) |> mutate(
        mu_x=rollmean(value, 20, mean, align="left", fill=0),
        mu_y=rollmean(cpa, 20, mean, align="left", fill=0)) 
mu <- data.frame(name=unique(fd$name), y=mean(cd$cpa))
md <- metadata(sub)$ths |>
    select(where(is.numeric)) |>
    summarise(across(everything(), mean))

# plotting

ggplot(fd, aes(mu_x, mu_y)) +
    facet_grid(~name) + geom_line(col="navy", linewidth=0.4) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=md$d, col="red", linewidth=0.4, lty=2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=md$a, col="red", linewidth=0.4, lty=2) +
    geom_hline(data=mu, aes(yintercept=y), col="blue", linewidth=0.4) +
    scale_x_continuous("FOV border distance (um)", expand=expansion(0.04)) +
    scale_y_continuous("RNA counts per um", n.breaks=3, expand=expansion(0.06)) +

# wrangling
cd <- data.frame(colData(sce))
cd$cpa <- with(cd, nCount_RNA/Area.um2)
df <- cbind(cd, d <- .d2b(cd)) |>
    pivot_longer(all_of(colnames(d))) |>
    mutate(value=value*1e3) |>
    mutate(name=factor(name, 
        c("t", "r", "b", "l"),
        c("top", "right", "bottom", "left")))
fd <- df |>
    group_by(name, value) |>
    summarise_at("cpa", mean) |>
    arrange(value) |> group_by(name) |> mutate(
        mu_x=rollmean(value, 20, mean, align="left", fill=0),
        mu_y=rollmean(cpa, 20, mean, align="left", fill=0)) 
mu <- data.frame(name=unique(fd$name), y=mean(cd$cpa))
md <- metadata(sub)$ths |>
    select(where(is.numeric)) |>
    summarise(across(everything(), mean))

# plotting
dy <- ceiling(max(fd$mu_y)/0.1)*0.1
ggplot(fd, aes(mu_x, mu_y)) +
    facet_grid(~name) + geom_line(col="navy", linewidth=0.4) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=md$d, col="red", linewidth=0.4, lty=2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=md$a, col="red", linewidth=0.4, lty=2) +
    geom_hline(data=mu, aes(yintercept=y), col="blue", linewidth=0.4) +
    scale_x_continuous("FOV border distance (um)", expand=expansion(0.04)) +
    scale_y_continuous("RNA counts per um", n.breaks=3, expand=expansion(0.06)) +
    theme(plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5)) + .thm_fig("bw") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0, 60), ylim=c(0, dy))

jst <- readRDS("outs/lv2.rds")





sce$lv1 <- (kid <- ist$clust)[match(colnames(sce), names(kid))]

idx <- match(colnames(sce), names(kid))
table(sce$lv2 <- kid[idx], exclude=NULL)

cs <- split(colnames(sce), sce$sid)
names(id) <- id <- names(cs)
r <- 0.02; k <- 101
# get radial neighborhood
is <- lapply(id, \(sid) {
    sub <- sce[, cs[[sid]]]
    xy <- "Center(X|Y)_global_mm"
    xy <- grep(xy, names(colData(sub)))
    xy <- as.matrix(colData(sub)[xy])
    nn <- nn2(xy, searchtype="radius", r=r, k=k)
    is <- nn$nn.idx[, -1]; is[is == 0] <- NA; is
})

# quantify each neighborhood's
# subpopulation composition
fq <- lapply(id, \(.) {
    ks <- (se <- sce[, cs[[.]]])$lv2
    ks[is.na(ks)] <- "tum"
    mx <- matrix(ks[is[[.]]], nrow=ncol(se))
    mx[is.na(mx)] <- ""
    names(kt) <- kt <- unique(ks)
    ns <- sapply(kt, \(k) rowSums(mx == k))
    data.frame(
        prop.table(ns, 1),
        row.names=colnames(se))
}) |> bind_rows(); fq[is.na(fq)] <- 0





set.seed(251210)

ns <- factor(km, labels=paste0("N", ns))

library(scran)
library(scater)
library(scuttle)
library(BiocParallel)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
source("code/_utils.R")
bp <- MulticoreParam(6)





sce <- readRDS("outs/nns.rds")
sig <- readRDS("outs/sig.rds")
ccc <- readRDS("outs/ccc.rds")





sig <- sig[, colnames(sce)]
ccc <- ccc[, colnames(sce)]
colData(sig) <- colData(sce)
colData(ccc) <- colData(sce)
altExp(sce, "UCell") <- sig
altExp(sce, "COMMOT") <- ccc





nm <- "data/raw/clinical.xlsx"
md <- readxl::read_xlsx(nm)
names(md) <- gsub("_|\\s", ".", names(md))
num <- c("MIPI", "LDH", "LDHNORML")
for (. in num) md[[.]] <- as.numeric(md[[.]])
fac <- c("Research.Biopsies.Index")
for (. in fac) md[[.]] <- as.factor(md[[.]])
is <- match(sce$sample_id, md$CLC.Id)
colData(sce) <- cbind(colData(sce), md[is, ])



Code
cs <- match(unique(sce$sid), sce$sid)
cd <- data.frame(colData(sce)[cs, ])
cd <- cd[order(factor(cd$typ)), ]
cd <- cd[order(factor(cd$gid)), ]
cd$sid <- factor(cd$sid, cd$sid)
cd <- cd[, c("typ", grepv("[a-z]id$", names(cd)), names(md))]
pal <- list(sid=.pal_sid, pid=.pal_pid, gid=.pal_gid, typ=.pal_typ)
aes <- list(
    theme_void(6),
    coord_equal(3/4, expand=FALSE),
    geom_tile(col="white", alpha=2/3),
    theme(axis.title.x=element_text(size=4, angle=90, vjust=0.5, margin=margin(t=2))))
ps <- lapply(names(cd), \(.) {
    col <- if (. %in% names(pal)) {
        scale_fill_manual(values=pal[[.]])
    } else if (is.numeric(cd[[.]])) {
        cd[[.]] <- round(cd[[.]], 2)
        scale_fill_gradientn(colors=c("white", "red"))
    }
    ggplot(cd, aes(0, sid, fill=.data[[.]])) + 
        aes + col + labs(x=., y=NULL) +
        geom_text(aes(label=.data[[.]]), size=1) 
})
ps[[1]] <- ps[[1]] + theme(axis.text.y=element_text(size=4, hjust=1, margin=margin(r=2)))
wrap_plots(ps, 
    nrow=1, guides="collect") &
    theme(legend.position="none")













set.seed(260317)
sce <- logNormCounts(sce)
tbl <- modelGeneVar(sce, block=sce$pid)
sel <- getTopHVGs(tbl, n=2e3)
rowData(sce)$sel <- rownames(sce) %in% sel
sce <- runPCA(sce, subset_row=sel)
sce <- runUMAP(sce, dimred="PCA", n_dimred=20)








saveRDS(sce, "outs/pro.rds")

.bin <- \(z, x, a=NULL, nx=10) {
    if (is.matrix(z)) {
        z <- SingleCellExperiment(assays=list(foo=z))
        a <- "foo"
    }

        include.lowest=TRUE,
        breaks=seq(0, 1, l=nx))
    mu <- aggregateAcrossCells(z, ids=xs,
        use.assay.type=a, statistics="mean")
    df <- data.frame(x=mu$ids, t(assay(mu)), check.names=FALSE)
}

# get point pattern using per-core 
# convex hull as window of observation
xy <- grep("global_mm", names(cd <- colData(sce)))
cs <- split(colnames(sce), sce$sid)
pp <- lapply(cs, \(.) {
    ow <- ripras(xy <- as.matrix(cd[., xy]))
    xy <- xy[which(cd$lv1[.] == "tum"), ]
    pp <- ppp(xy[,1], xy[,2], window=ow)
})
# visualize kernel density estimate
# of tumoral density across cores
kd <- lapply(pp, density.ppp)
par(mfrow=c(4, 5), mar=c(1,0,0,0))
for (. in names(kd)) plot(kd[[.]], main=., col=pals::jet())












# estimate tumoral density at
# observed cellular coordinates
fn <- lapply(pp, densityfun)
ds <- lapply(names(fn), \(.) {
    xy <- cd[cs[[.]], xy]
    fn[[.]](xy[,1], xy[,2], drop=FALSE)
})
is <- match(colnames(sce), unlist(cs))
df <- data.frame(colData(sce), kde=unlist(ds)[is])
xs <- seq(min(ds <- .q(sqrt(df$kde))), max(ds), l=26)
df$bin <- cut(ds, breaks=xs, include.lowest=TRUE)
hist(ds, n=100, 
    xlab="q-scaled tumoral density", 
    ylab="# cells", main="")
abline(v=xs, col="red")

names(id) <- id <- names(cs)
r <- 0.02; k <- 101
# get radial neighborhood
is <- lapply(id, \(sid) {
    sub <- sce[, cs[[sid]]]
    xy <- "Center(X|Y)_global_mm"
    xy <- grep(xy, names(colData(sub)))
    xy <- as.matrix(colData(sub)[xy])
    nn <- nn2(xy, searchtype="radius", r=r, k=k)
    is <- nn$nn.idx[, -1]; is[is == 0] <- NA; is
})

library(scran)
library(scater)
library(scuttle)
library(BiocParallel)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
source("code/_utils.R")
bp <- MulticoreParam(8)





sce <- readRDS("outs/fil.rds")
sig <- readRDS("outs/sig.rds")
ccc <- readRDS("outs/ccc.rds")
ctx <- readRDS("outs/ctx.rds")
fqs <- readRDS("outs/fqs.rds")
ist <- readRDS("outs/lv1.rds")
jst <- readRDS("outs/lv2.rds")




idx <- names(kid <- ist$clust)
kid[kid == "epi"] <- "str"
sce$lv1 <- kid[match(colnames(sce), idx)]
kid <- lapply(jst, \(.) .$clust)
idx <- names(kid <- unlist(unname(kid)))
sce$lv2 <- kid[match(colnames(sce), idx)]
# fix <- sce$lv2 %in% setdiff(sce$lv1, NA)
# sce$lv1[fix] <- as.character(sce$lv2[fix])
# colData(sce)$fqs <- fqs[colnames(sce), ]
# sce$ctx <- ctx[colnames(sce)]
# colData(sig) <- colData(sce)
# colData(ccc) <- colData(sce)
altExp(sce, "UCell") <- sig
# altExp(sce, "COMMOT") <- ccc








set.seed(260130)
sce <- logNormCounts(sce)
tbl <- modelGeneVar(sce)
sel <- getTopHVGs(tbl, n=2e3)
sel <- rownames(sce) %in% sel
rowData(sce)$sel <- sel
sce <- runPCA(sce, subset_row=sel)
sce <- runUMAP(sce, dimred="PCA", n_dimred=20)





set.seed(260131)
idx <- split(colnames(sce), sce$lv1)
names(ids) <- ids <- names(idx)
lys <- bplapply(ids, \(.) {
    sel <- rownames(jst[[.]]$profiles)
    sel <- rownames(sce) %in% sel
    rowData(sce)[[.]] <- sel
    sce <- runPCA(sce[, idx[[.]]], subset_row=sel)
    runUMAP(sce, dimred="PCA", n_dimred=10)
}, BPPARAM=bp)





# stash split reductions
for (a in c("PCA", "UMAP")) {
    b <- switch(a, PCA="PCB", "UMAQ")
    dr <- lapply(lys, reducedDim, a)
    dr <- do.call(rbind, dr)
    cs <- match(colnames(sce), rownames(dr))
    reducedDim(sce, b) <- dr[cs, ]
}
# stash feature selections
sel <- sapply(ids, \(.) rowData(lys[[.]])[[.]])
rowData(sce) <- cbind(rowData(sce), sel); sce

lys <- bplapply(ids, \(.) {
    sel <- rownames(jst[[.]]$profiles)
    sel <- rownames(sce) %in% sel
    rowData(sce)[[.]] <- sel
    sce <- runPCA(sce[, idx[[.]]], subset_row=sel)
    runUMAP(sce, dimred="PCA", n_dimred=10)
}, BPPARAM=bp)





# stash split reductions
for (a in c("PCA", "UMAP")) {
    b <- switch(a, PCA="PCB", "UMAQ")
    dr <- lapply(lys, reducedDim, a)
    dr <- do.call(rbind, dr)
    cs <- match(colnames(sce), rownames(dr))
    reducedDim(sce, b) <- dr[cs, ]
}
# stash feature selections
sel <- sapply(ids, \(.) rowData(lys[[.]])[[.]])
rowData(sce) <- cbind(rowData(sce), sel); sce

# convex hull as window of observation
xy <- grep("global_mm", names(cd <- colData(sce)))
cs <- split(colnames(sce), sce$sid)
pp <- lapply(cs, \(.) {
    ow <- ripras(xy <- as.matrix(cd[., xy]))
    xy <- xy[which(cd$lv1[.] == "tum"), ]
    pp <- ppp(xy[,1], xy[,2], window=ow)
})
# visualize kernel density estimate
# of tumoral density across cores
kd <- lapply(pp, density.ppp)
par(mfrow=c(4, 5), mar=c(1,0,0,0))
for (. in names(kd)) plot(kd[[.]], main=., col=pals::jet())












# estimate tumoral density at
# observed cellular coordinates
fn <- lapply(pp, densityfun)
ds <- lapply(names(fn), \(.) {
    xy <- cd[cs[[.]], xy]
    fn[[.]](xy[,1], xy[,2], drop=FALSE)
})
is <- match(colnames(sce), unlist(cs))
df <- data.frame(colData(sce), kde=unlist(ds)[is])
xs <- seq(min(ds <- .q(sqrt(df$kde))), max(ds), l=26)

hist(ds, n=100,

.plt_hm <- \(df, gs, x, xo=TRUE, yo=TRUE, ax=TRUE) {
    # wrangling
    mu <- df |>
        group_by(!!!sym(x)) |>
        summarise(across(all_of(gs), mean))
    # scaling
    fd <- mu |>
        mutate(across(all_of(gs), .z)) |>
        pivot_longer(all_of(gs))
    # ordering
    mx <- pivot_wider(fd)
    my <- as.matrix(mx[, -1])
    rownames(my) <- seq(nrow(my))
    xo <- if (xo) scale_x_discrete(limits=mx[[1]][as.integer(.xo(my))])
    yo <- if (yo) scale_y_discrete(limits=.yo(my))
    # aesthetics
    ax <- if (ax) theme(
        #axis.ticks=element_blank(),
        axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.y=element_text(size=3),
        axis.text.x=element_text(size=4, angle=45, vjust=1, hjust=1)) else
        theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(), axis.ticks.x=element_blank())
    # plotting
    ggplot(fd, aes(.data[[x]], name, fill=value)) +
        scale_fill_gradientn(
            "z-scaled\nmean score",
            colors=.pal_ccc,
            limits=c(-2.5,2.5), breaks=seq(-2,2,2)) +
        labs(y=NULL) + coord_equal(2/3, expand=FALSE) + 
        geom_tile() + xo + yo + .thm_fig_c("bw") + ax
}

.plt_hm <- \(df, gs, x, xo=TRUE, yo=TRUE, ax=TRUE) {
    # wrangling
    mu <- df |>
        group_by(!!!sym(x)) |>
        summarise(across(all_of(gs), mean))
    # scaling
    fd <- mu |>
        mutate(across(all_of(gs), .z)) |>
        pivot_longer(all_of(gs))
    # ordering
    mx <- pivot_wider(fd)
    my <- as.matrix(mx[, -1])
    rownames(my) <- seq(nrow(my))
    xo <- if (xo) scale_x_discrete(limits=mx[[1]][as.integer(.xo(my))])
    yo <- if (yo) scale_y_discrete(limits=.yo(my))
    # aesthetics
    ax <- if (ax) theme(
        #axis.ticks=element_blank(),
        axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.y=element_text(size=3),
        axis.text.x=element_text(size=4, angle=45, vjust=1, hjust=1)) else
        theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(), axis.ticks.x=element_blank())
    # plotting
    ggplot(fd, aes(.data[[x]], name, fill=value)) +
        scale_fill_gradientn(
            "z-scaled\nmean score",
            colors=.pal_ccc,
            limits=c(-2.5,2.5), breaks=seq(-2,2,2)) +
        labs(y=NULL) + coord_equal(2/3, expand=FALSE) + 
        geom_tile() + xo + yo + .thm_fig_c("bw") + ax
}
